item.title: Nasdaq Futures Rebound From Tech Selloff, Oil Dips: Markets Wrap
item.description: US equity-index futures rebounded from last week’s chip rout, offering some respite ahead of key earnings that may set the market’s direction amid mounting pressure on the artificial intelligence trade. Oil fell.
item.dc:creator: Anand Krishnamoorthy

item.title: Europe’s Unity on China Can Move the Needle: Eskelund
item.description: European Union Chamber of Commerce in China President, Jens Eskelund, says a more unified European approach to China could reshape trade relations. He joined Paul Allen on Bloomberg’s Insight with Haslinda Amin to discuss EU-China trade tensions and the outlook for European businesses in China. (Source: Bloomberg)
